what: Fetch Hacker News stories' top comments from HN's Firebase API into a shared discussion block, and let a story with a blocked article but a substantive discussion be stored readable with content_basis = discussion, summarized as discussion and shown that way in the TUI and CLI, for HN and Reddit.
why: Design: docs/work/hn-discussion/design.md. HN arrives as plain RSS with no comments read, blocked articles leave only a Comments link, and the link-without-article rule plus the substantive check make discussion-only stories title-only; the operator decided on 2026-10-10 to summarize the discussion instead.

criteria.given: a recorded HN feed entry whose comments link is news.ycombinator.com/item?id=<id> and recorded Firebase responses for that story with a deleted and a dead kid among its first kids
criteria.when: the RSS fetcher builds the item
criteria.then: it fails if the discussion block is missing, out of HN's kids order, longer than max_comments, contains a deleted or dead comment or raw HTML; otherwise it carries the first max_comments live comments in kids order as plain text under the shared discussion header

criteria.given: a recorded Ask HN entry whose link is the HN item itself
criteria.then: it fails if its body is not the item's own text; otherwise it is, followed by the discussion block

criteria.given: content of a link line plus a discussion block with prose, and separately a link line plus an empty discussion block
criteria.when: readability_failure and title_only_reason run, and build_llm_analysis records the result
criteria.then: it fails if the first is title-only or lacks content_basis = discussion, or the second is readable; otherwise the first is readable with content_basis = discussion and the second is title-only as content:link_without_article, for both an HN and a Reddit item, and the test is shown red against the current rule

criteria.given: a discussion-basis item analyzed through the recorded LLM stub
criteria.then: it fails if the request does not tell the model the article is unavailable and the text is discussion, or if a substantive thread's item ends model:not_substantive; otherwise the request carries the discussion note and discussion-based substantive wording, and a one-line joke thread's item still ends model:not_substantive

criteria.given: an HN story whose Firebase calls fail
criteria.when: the RSS fetcher builds the item
criteria.then: it fails if the fetch cycle errors or the failure goes unrecorded; otherwise the item is built as it would have been and its analysis carries comments_outcome with outcome fetch_failed

criteria.given: an item whose analysis has content_basis = discussion
criteria.when: the TUI reader renders it and the CLI's item view prints it
criteria.then: it fails if either omits 'from the discussion — article unavailable'; otherwise both show it, and an item without the key shows nothing new
it fails on any failing check; otherwise its last line is `verify: PASS`

outOfScope: Each HN story costs up to 1 + max_comments extra API calls per fetch cycle.
Summaries of discussion-basis items describe what commenters said, which can be wrong about the article; the basis marker is the reader's warning.
stakes: An HN RSS item carries its top max_comments comments, in HN's ranked order, under the shared discussion header, with deleted and dead comments skipped and HTML converted to text.
An Ask or Show HN self post's body is the item's own text.

A story whose article fetch failed but whose discussion has prose is stored readable with content_basis = discussion and summarized as discussion, for HN and Reddit; one with no discussion prose stays title-only as content:link_without_article.
For a discussion-basis item, the model's substantive verdict is about the discussion, so a substantive thread is not marked model:not_substantive and an empty one still is.
A failed HN comment fetch records comments_outcome and leaves the item as it would otherwise be.
The TUI reader and the CLI item view show 'from the discussion — article unavailable' for a discussion-basis item.
HN API behavior is tested from recorded cassettes with no network.
